"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从管理后台开始，他们逐渐扩展成完整的产品生态。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但核心动力一直没变："}, {"insert": "解决开发者真实面临的问题，减少重复工作，让开发更快更愉快。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "Clevision 的起步很务实。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期数据给了信心——证明他们解决的是真实问题，也资助了后续产品开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ThemeSelection 是个重要里程碑，让他们从市场平台独立出来，直接建立客户关系。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不再只靠 SEO 和博客。他们通过最佳 UI/UX 设计、灵活的产品授权、顶级质量产品、SEO、全渠道策略和社区驱动分发来推动增长。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们初期过度专注产品，但增长往往来自分发和产品本身一样多。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和所有 bootstrapped 生意一样，招聘和规模化合适团队也是个学习曲线。找到既对齐产品质量又对齐长期愿景的人需要时间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ajay 的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "公开构建、快速验证、尽早聚焦 USP。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "公开构建意味着分享你在做什么、进展如何、甚至挣扎。帮你吸引早期用户、获得反馈、建立信任，有时甚至能在产品完全准备好前找到第一批客户。Shadcn Studio 就是完美例子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "快速验证，后面再完美：不要花几个月打磨却不知道人们是否想要。快速做个简单版本放在用户面前，收集反馈，基于真实需求迭代。早期动力比完美更重要。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从 MVP 开始，定义你的 USP：建最小版本解决一个清晰问题，清楚是什么让产品与众不同。你的独特价值不必复杂，但得让人有理由选你而不是竞品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开始时，"}, {"insert": "学习速度比建造速度更重要。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和用户聊、持续改进、让反馈塑造产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目标是构建一个既提供影响力又提供自由的 SaaS 生意。创造持续解决真实问题的产品，同时有灵活性做自己喜欢的事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "随着时间推移，目标是可持续增长、保持独立、构建一个支持创新和平衡生活方式的商业模式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你想做一单大买卖，还是像 Ajay 一样，慢慢建一个帝国？"}]}
content_en: From theme templates to 65k monthly he built developer tools empire in 7 years. 2018 he and partner still working at software company discovered every project had to rebuild admin dashboard. One thought flashed why not make ready-to-use? 7 years later they make 65k monthly. Ajay Patel is 15 year veteran. Worked in tech industry 15 years did entrepreneur programmer product innovator. Clevision is he and Vrushank founded in 2018. At that time they still worked at software company. Almost all applications need admin dashboard but few good solutions. Building UI from scratch is repetitive time-consuming slows every project progress. They saw opportunity why not make ready-to-use themselves? This idea became Clevision goal is simplify development help teams deliver faster. Starting from admin dashboard they gradually expanded into complete product ecosystem. But core motivation never changed solve real problems developers face reduce repetitive work make development faster happier. Clevision started pragmatically. First product released on Envato ThemeForest. This helped them quickly validate idea. This channel still brings 15-20k monthly. Early data gave confidence proved they solved real problem.
